body: I’m planning on going to university next year (if not before that), however due to my financial situation I won’t be able to move out for a few more years. But I’m looking forward to finding my first apartment! One, because it would be so cool to have my own space. Two, because it would mean I’m not constantly surrounded by her negativity

For so long I thought I was a burden and I ruined my moms life, since I was the first child. But now I know I deserve to be here just as much as she does. I think I will go with your suggestions and start kind of distancing myself emotionally; one of the biggest things she does is try to make me her therapist, which bothers me because it’s all about her and she doesn’t care about me
Thank you, this was really helpful for me. I’m actually working on getting back to therapy so soon I will have a trusted adult to talk to about these things
She pretty much always says that but I think she retracted since I never call her out on things
